320: Rabbi Shimon began and said: "Blast the beast of the reed[s] (kaneh), the herd of bulls among the peoples, the calves" (Psalms 68:31). "Blast the beast" - that is the beast that Esav grabbed a hold of. "The reed" - We have learned that on the day that King Shlomo married the daughter of Pharoah, Gavriel appeared and planted a reed in the Great Sea, and the city of Rome was built upon it. What is a kaneh? It is the male of that evil beast, and it has a small side that grabs holiness. And that is that kaneh that he planted in the Great Sea. And because of that, it rules over the world. And about this rulership, it is written (Isaiah 19:6), "reed and rush shall decay." "Kaneh" - it is the rulership and head of all kingdoms. Moreover, kaneh - that the Holy One, blessed be He, has prepared to break it like this reed.
